concept: Full-body concept art of a giant monstrous serpent for a video game. A very long scaly body, dark emerald green with black diamond patterns and a pale yellow belly, a large head with slit yellow eyes, two long curved fangs and a forked tongue, a bony frill behind the head. Rig-ready pose: the front of the body is raised upright like a cobra ready to strike; behind it the rest of the body lies flat on the ground and stretches far away to the right side of the image in one long, wide, open curve shaped like a letter C, the tail tip far from the head. Absolutely no coils, no loops, no rings: the body never touches itself and never crosses itself, there is empty ground between every part of the body. Seen from the front: its raised head faces the camera. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground texture, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: giant monstrous serpent, long dark emerald scaly body with black diamond pattern and pale belly, raised cobra-like head with slit yellow eyes, fangs and bony frill
